failure_modes.cause: Operating pressure (1.5 bar) is only marginally above the calculated minimum safe pressure (1.22 bar) for acetonitrile at 50°C; minor pressure drops or pump fluctuations can cause vaporization at the pump inlet.
failure_modes.mitigation: Increase BPR setpoint to ≥2.5 bar or pressurize feed reservoirs to ensure NPSH > 0.5 bar margin.

failure_modes.mode: Reactor coil blockage due to precipitation
failure_modes.cause: Base-catalyzed condensation may produce insoluble salts or byproducts; low flow rate (0.087 mL/min) and narrow diameter (0.75 mm) increase susceptibility to clogging if solubility limits are exceeded.
failure_modes.mitigation: Perform solubility screening of all components at 50°C; install inline filter or increase coil diameter for initial runs.

failure_modes.mode: Incomplete mixing leading to poor conversion
failure_modes.cause: Laminar flow regime (Re=5) in a long coil (24 m) relies on diffusion; if reactant diffusion coefficients differ significantly, concentration gradients may persist, reducing yield below the target 50%.
failure_modes.mitigation: Validate mixing efficiency using a fast kinetic probe reaction (e.g., iodine clock) at the same Re and geometry.

single_points_of_failure: Back Pressure Regulator (BPR) — failure leads to immediate depressurization and solvent boiling
Syringe Pump — single pump failure stops entire process with no redundancy
validation_experiments: Run blank acetonitrile at 50°C and 1.5 bar for 2 hours; monitor pressure stability and check for cavitation noise or flow rate drift >2%.
Perform a 'worst-case' solubility test: run reaction mixture at 2x concentration for 10 residence times; inspect coil for precipitate buildup.
Conduct a mixing efficiency test using a fast, diffusion-limited model reaction (e.g., acid-base neutralization with pH indicator) to confirm homogeneity at Re=5.
